Dialogue_Text: Ah, here it is. Now you see why you may want to see the book. It's Paginae Sanguinariae Bhaalensis—The Blood Pages of Bhaal.
Ah. You're back. Does it mean you made your decision? Will you help me investigate this book?
Bhaal? Be careful, <CHARNAME>. I think we all know that nothing good can come out of interacting with that kind of book.
Such a tome, so very close to my estate. It does elicit some reasonable discomfort. I think you know why, <CHARNAME>.
I am quite sure you cannot wait to read it already, <CHARNAME>. Don't even try to disagree, as I would not believe you.
Finally, something truly worth my attention. (I wonder if we could get this tome out of this damp place. But I doubt these fools would cooperate.)
This isn't something I expected to see here. <CHARNAME>, we don't know what this tome could do, so keep that in mind when even standing next to it.

This one is slightly different from the books above, and there are parts of this book that... remain locked away from me. Whenever I try to turn the page, there is this urge in my mind to resign. Some sort of mind-bending barrier. As if it was waiting for someone else to turn that page. And that's even after placing this book in the reservoir filled with holy water!
That is why I thought that perhaps you'll be able to help. Perhaps you will be able to turn the page, learn more about what's written in this book.
So this one is actually about discovery, and less about fights, yes?
So, to make this clear: you want me to read this book and check what it says.
Yes. I'll help you with the book. I have a feeling that—I may need to learn that, too. After all, it's marked with Bhaal's symbol. It must mean something that I'm here.
No, I won't do that. I don't want anything to do with Bhaal and strange books marked with his symbol!
I may need to think about this for a while longer. Give me some time.

Yes. I mean—I cannot be sure how the book is going to react to you, if it's going to let you read it, or if it will try to defend itself, I really don't know. But I can still hope it will be mostly about discovery.
Will you help me understand what's in there? I need to know.
Yes. I'll help you. I have a feeling that—I may need to learn that, too. After all, it's marked with Bhaal's symbol. It must mean something that I'm here.
No, I don't think it's a good idea. I don't want anything to do with Bhaal and strange books marked with his symbol!
I may need to think about this first. Give me some time.
Wonderful news! Thank you!
All you need to do is turn the page and... perhaps then we'll see if your heritage is the key to understanding this tome and whatever is written in it.
I understand. It must be somewhat personal for you. Nevertheless, let me say that I am still quite impressed with all your fights here, at the Ink Gallery.
You don't need to worry about the book. I respect your decision, and we shall speak no more about it. Safe travels!
Of course. I understand. Let me know once you decide if you want to participate in this.
